summary: Frontend-only validation of two PAUSE changes: (1) Plus Jakarta Sans typography adoption and (2) reader single-screen chapter layout with teaser handling. All six chapters of the target story (v8-lez-how-revolutions-start-the-ingredients-that-repeat) render in a single screen at both 390x844 and 375x667 viewports; mouse-wheel navigation advances exactly one chapter per gesture; no runtime errors; fonts load correctly (computed font-family resolves to 'PlusJakartaSans_*' across all tested surfaces including onboarding, bottom tabs, reader headings and body). Only non-blocking warnings observed (RN web deprecations: textShadow/pointerEvents, and a reanimated easing fallback on web).

issues: Reanimated: 'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' — the custom cubic easing used by the slow autofocus scroll (SCROLL_EASING = Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)) silently falls back to linear on web. Behaviour is still correct but the paced-scroll feel is lost in the web preview. Low priority / web-only.

react_native_issues.issue: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'textShadow'); 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Appears repeatedly in the console but has no functional impact. Not an Expo-related deprecation listed in the testing playbook — only RN-web style-prop migration noise.

action_items: No code changes required for this iteration — both features are working as intended. Optional cleanup: migrate any remaining `textShadowOffset/textShadowColor/textShadowRadius` and `pointerEvents` component props to the new APIs to clear console warnings on RN-web.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/reader-section.tsx: shrink loop (useEffect on overflow) depends on `bodyH` which is updated by onLayout — on web onLayout can fire late, so the first render may show the pre-shrink layout briefly before stabilising. Measured during testing it still converged within the normal paint cycle; not a blocker.

app/deep-dive/[id].tsx: `teaserHidden` is read by every ChapterHeading via useDerivedValue — correct and efficient on Reanimated 3; verified no stale-value flashes when switching the hidden flag between chapters.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded guest flow and existing story v8-lez-how-revolutions-start-the-ingredients-that-repeat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reader page uses custom mouse-wheel paging (step() in app/deep-dive/[id].tsx). Use `await page.mouse.wheel(0, 700)` with ~1.5s waits between calls to advance exactly one chapter. Section heights are measured via `[data-testid="deep-dive-chapter-N"]`.getBoundingClientRect(). Expected height = viewportH - headerBottom (≈780 at 390x844, ≈603 at 375x667). Teaser overlap must be checked by comparing innermost text node bottoms vs the section bottom.
